official_language_evidence.semantic_support: An empty input yields an empty array. Regexp delimiters split at their matches and may retain leading empty fields; default suppression concerns trailing empty fields.
A single out-of-range integer index yields nil.
A single out-of-range integer character index yields nil.
Substitution changes receiver in place; no substitution returns nil. Caller in source ignores return value.
Whitespace is removed in place; unchanged receiver yields nil as return value. Caller ignores return value; this alone does not replace array element with nil.
Calling an unavailable method on a receiver raises NoMethodError under ordinary method lookup.
Standard nil receiver does not define strip! or element [].
